Hi Stephanie,

Thanks — I signed up via the self-serve flow this morning and got the quickstart working in our eval account. Our security team wants to run a short privacy-first POC for an on-prem / VPC deployment to validate tenant isolation, key management, and audit logs before we proceed to procurement.

Could we schedule a technical POC walkthrough next week? Prefer mornings Pacific. Attendees: me (security lead), Samir (platform), and our procurement contact (procurement). We may need a short checklist of evidence (SOC2, audit logs) in advance so our security reviewers can triage.

Hi Olivia — great to hear you got the quickstart live and thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely run a privacy-focused POC walkthrough that covers tenant isolation, KMS integration, audit logs, and the on-prem deployment footprint.

A few quick notes and next steps:
- I'll run the tech walkthrough (30–45m). Vivek (cc'd) will join for deployment/security config and to discuss the Dedicated vs Private tradeoffs.
- Can you confirm the preferred date(s) and timezone? You mentioned Pacific mornings — do any of these work for your team next week: Tue 6/29 9:30–10:15 PT, Wed 6/30 10:00–10:45 PT, or Thu 7/1 8:30–9:15 PT?
- I'll attach a short SOC2 evidence checklist and a POC scope sheet for Nexa to triage ahead of the meeting. If procurement wants to join for a quick intro we can include them — otherwise they can get the evidence pack after the walkthrough.

I attached the checklist and the scope doc. Let me know which slot works and I’ll send a calendar invite with dial-in and a lightweight agenda.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
